Thanks for sending these over — the agenda looks great. Quick heads up: I just had a personal scheduling change and will be out of town Oct 6–9 (family obligation that just moved). Alex will still be onsite Oct 7 but will be pulled into back-to-back meetings most of the morning.

Options that would work for us:
  • Move the full session to Tue, Oct 12 (Alex + I both available)
  • Keep Oct 7 but split into two compact sessions (two 45-minute blocks) with a recording for the parts Alex or I miss
  • Run the live portion Oct 7 and schedule a short follow-up for procurement & integration the week after

We also need an attendee list to send to our facilities team for building access.

Apologies for the late notice — travel changed after I booked flights. If you have any teammates who can cover the Oct 7 slot in my absence, that would also be helpful.

Thanks — julie

Hi Julie,

No worries — thanks for the update and your options. We can do any of the three; below are the tradeoffs and a recommended path:

Option A — Move to Tue, Oct 12
  • Pros: full team presence, best for procurement conversation
  • Cons: delays decision cadence by ~5 days

Option B — Keep Oct 7 but split into two 45-minute sessions (we record both) — RECOMMENDED IF YOU WANT TO KEEP MOMENTUM
  • We can run: 9:00–9:45 (architecture + integration) + 10:15–11:00 (live demo + Q&A)
  • We will record both blocks and share a short digest for attendees who miss either part
  • We can forward the procurement-focused follow-up to the week of Oct 12 if needed

Option C — Live demo Oct 7 + separate procurement follow-up
  • Similar to B but shorter live scope — good if Alex only has one window available

If you prefer we can have Stephanie Nguyen (she's our solutions lead and has run the Redpine POC plan before) cover the 9:00–9:45 architecture session on Oct 7 so you and Alex can join the demo block. Stephanie, can you confirm availability?

Proposed fallback schedule if you confirm split:
  • Thu Oct 7 — 9:00–9:45 — Architecture (Stephanie) — recorded
  • Thu Oct 7 — 10:15–11:00 — Live demo + Q&A (Marissa) — recorded

Please reply with which option you prefer and a final attendee list for access. If you pick Oct 12 we will send an updated calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa
